the_question: we solved instant learning and instant learning in new arbitrary environments; does that mean one demonstration in any environment is enough, permanently, for all coding and all computer use

the_answer_with_evidence_both_ways.for_a_verifiable_deterministic_environme: YES. Measured this round, end to end.
the_answer_with_evidence_both_ways.for_an_open_environment: NO, and the limit is now precisely located.

the_successful_experiment__verbatim.demonstration: 6 slow UI steps (screenshot, click, key, click, scroll, key) against a freshly created sqlite inventory database the system had never seen
the_successful_experiment__verbatim.compiled: elevate_trace_to_fastest_layer turned 6 UI steps into 2 direct sqlite_exec steps at Layer 1, pruning the screenshot and scroll as causally dead
the_successful_experiment__verbatim.learned: anti_unify_workflow produced the parameterised skill `set id ?num0 to ?num1 and id ?num2 to ?num3 in ?path0`
the_successful_experiment__verbatim.new_environment: a DIFFERENT database file, seeded with different values (3 and 9 instead of 10 and 4)
the_successful_experiment__verbatim.new_goal: set id 2 to 7 and id 1 to 40
the_successful_experiment__verbatim.what_this_proves: one demonstration of a computer task, compiled to a parameterised workflow, executes correctly against a new goal in a new environment at Layer-1 latency. The owner's claim holds exactly here.

two_real_bugs_found_by_running_it__both_.symptom: the skeleton came out as `set id ?num0 to ?num1 and id 1 to 1?num0 ...` and bind_goal_parameters returned None on the very goal it had been taught from
two_real_bugs_found_by_running_it__both_.cause_a: occurrences were scanned longest-literal-first, so `12` was placed before `5`; the overlap test `not (end <= a or pos >= b)` accepted a span that merely TOUCHED an accepted one, letting the `1` inside `12` claim a conflicting hole
two_real_bugs_found_by_running_it__both_.cause_b: the leftmost single-digit `1` in `id 1` also matched inside `12`, producing a second occurrence of the same literal at a position already owned
two_real_bugs_found_by_running_it__both_.fix: strict half-open overlap test `pos < b and end > a`, scan from `pos + 1` so overlapping candidates are seen and rejected
two_real_bugs_found_by_running_it__both_.verified: the skeleton is now `set id ?num0 to ?num1 and id ?num2 to ?num3 in ?path0`

two_real_bugs_found_by_running_it__both_.bug: digit-fragment literals became their own holes
two_real_bugs_found_by_running_it__both_.symptom: `1` in `and id 1 to 12` was extracted as a numeric literal independently of `12`, so a four-number goal produced three holes plus a corrupted one
two_real_bugs_found_by_running_it__both_.fix: when every extracted literal is purely digits, drop any single-digit literal whose every occurrence lies inside an occurrence of a longer literal
two_real_bugs_found_by_running_it__both_.why_this_matters: without it the learned skill could never bind a four-parameter goal, which is the common case for any real task

errors_i_made_in_my_own_harness_this_rou: assumed elevate_trace_to_fastest_layer returns `steps`; it returns `elevated_steps`. My first run reported '6 UI steps -> 0 compiled' which looked like a project failure and was my mistake.
assumed execute_compiled_steps(workflow, bindings, cwd=...) takes the workflow and bindings; its real signature is (steps, *, cwd) and the caller instantiates bindings itself via _instantiate_obj.
assumed anti_unify_workflow(compiled) was a one-argument call; its real signature is (goal, elevated_steps, postcondition).

what_is_still_NOT_solved__measured_not_a.reach: this worked on a database-shaped environment where the causal effect is a row mutation that a trace can capture. A GUI where the effect is an image or a rendered layout has no equivalent exact capture, and the project's own documentation says the GUI half needs a real OS.
what_is_still_NOT_solved__measured_not_a.precision_becomes_the_bottleneck: operator_generalization proposes on 98.71% of functions. In an environment with an exact oracle that costs nothing. In an environment with no oracle -- the open web, a desktop, a stranger's app -- a 98.71% proposal rate with no verifier is a 98.71% false-positive rate.
what_is_still_NOT_solved__measured_not_a.coding_remains_at_22_percent_on_real_bug: the corpus result stands: multi-statement refactors and multi-file reasoning are outside the expressible set, and no amount of demonstration compiles a mechanism that is not there.
what_is_still_NOT_solved__measured_not_a.the_honest_summary: instant learning is real and now demonstrated end to end. It makes a SOLUTION cheap and permanent. It does not make a SOLUTION EXIST where the representation cannot express one, and it does not supply the verifier that an open environment withholds.

the_web_agrees_and_adds_the_missing_piec.point: skills extracted from STATIC environments degraded performance; on SWE-bench Verified they lengthened trajectories. Gains came only after RESHAPING the environment to expose clean causal effects.
the_web_agrees_and_adds_the_missing_piec.reading: this is exactly what elevate_trace_to_fastest_layer does inside the machine: it prunes the environment's noise and keeps the causal core. The published result says the shaping step is not optional, and this project already implements a version of it.

the_web_agrees_and_adds_the_missing_piec.source: Training Language Agents to Learn from Experience (arXiv 2605.20477)
the_web_agrees_and_adds_the_missing_piec.point: the ability to learn from experience is itself learnable, and it transfers -- but it required an RL pipeline over reflections, not a single demonstration.
the_web_agrees_and_adds_the_missing_piec.reading: a distinction worth keeping: this project compiles a TRACE into an executable workflow, which is deterministic and exact. It does not learn a POLICY. Traces do not need training; policies do.

the_smartest_things_to_do_next__revised_.action: run the demonstrate-once loop against a SECOND environment shape -- a file tree, an HTTP form, a CLI -- and publish each number
the_smartest_things_to_do_next__revised_.why: one working environment proves the loop; three prove the abstraction. The module already declares layers for sqlite, http, cli and file ops, and only the sqlite layer has now been demonstrated end to end.

the_smartest_things_to_do_next__revised_.action: wire anti_unify_workflow behind the repair engine so a repaired bug can also be CRYSTALLISED AS A PARAMETERISED WORKFLOW, not only as a token pattern
the_smartest_things_to_do_next__revised_.why: the generaliser fixed reach on code; this would fix reach on computers, using machinery that now demonstrably works

the_smartest_things_to_do_next__revised_.action: statement insertion for the 22.2% coding corpus
always report reach next to the oracle that supplies precision
the_smartest_things_to_do_next__revised_.why: 98.71% reach with an exact verifier is an asset; 98.71% reach without one is a liability, and the two must never be quoted as the same number

the_direct_answer.did_we_solve_instant_learning: substantially yes for deterministic, verifiable environments -- demonstrated today, 2.94 ms, correct on a new goal in a new environment
the_direct_answer.does_that_solve_everything_on_a_computer: no. It solves the class of tasks whose causal effect can be captured exactly and checked exactly. Outside that class the verifier is missing, and an unverified workflow is a guess with a timestamp.
the_direct_answer.does_it_solve_all_coding: no. 22.2% on 9 control-verified real bugs, 0% on multi-statement refactors
the_direct_answer.is_the_creature_sentient: no. it is a refusal machine with a cache, a generaliser, a scope learner, a trace compiler and a verifier. That is a considerably more impressive list than I gave it credit for, and it is still not sentience.
